video.title: I Rebranded My Roblox Game. Here Are the Real Results
video.description:
I renamed my Roblox project from Wild Rebellion to Wild Racing. In this update, I show the actual ad dashboard, explain which player metric I am watching, and share what I am changing next.

This is an honest development update: the first downvote, ad results that look worse, the reasoning behind the rebrand, AI-assisted fixes and translations, beta testing, and a quick time-trial test. The results and my interpretation are from the recording on October 29, 2026. I discuss the rebrand and ads together; this is not a controlled test proving which caused the change.

Play Wild Racing: https://www.roblox.com/games/137414447181099/
